# Third-party software bundled in `www/vendor`

| Library | Used for | License |
|---|---|---|
| [PDF.js](https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js) (`vendor/pdfjs`) | Displaying PDF pages | Apache-2.0 |
| [JSZip](https://stuk.github.io/jszip/) (`vendor/jszip.min.js`) | Reading .docx / .pptx files | MIT (or GPL-3.0) |
| [pdf-lib](https://pdf-lib.js.org/) (`vendor/pdf-lib.min.js`) | Exporting annotated notebooks as PDF | MIT |
| [Capacitor](https://capacitorjs.com/) (build time) | Wrapping the web app as an Android APK | MIT |

Inkwell itself (everything else in this folder) is an original app and does not use any code,
artwork or branding from other note-taking apps.
